message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI - API

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

  pull_request:
    branches:
      - develop
      - master
      - release/**
    paths:
      - "forms-flow-api/**"

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash
    working-directory: ./forms-flow-api

jobs:

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version:
          - "3.13.16"

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 #v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: forms-flow-api/requirements/dev.txt

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements/dev.txt

      - name: Pylint
        run: |
          pylint --rcfile=setup.cfg src/formsflow_api

      - name: Flake8
        run: |
          flake8 src/formsflow_api tests


  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version:
          - "3.13.16"

    env:
      FLASK_ENV: "testing"
      DATABASE_URL_TEST: "postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres"
      FORMSFLOW_API_URL: "http://localhost:5000"
      KEYCLOAK_URL: "http://localhost:8081"
      KEYCLOAK_URL_REALM: "forms-flow-ai"
      KEYCLOAK_BPM_CLIENT_SECRET: "demo"
      JWT_OIDC_WELL_KNOWN_CONFIG: "http://localhost:8081/auth/realms/forms-flow-ai/.well-known/openid-configuration"
      JWT_OIDC_ALGORITHMS: "RS256"
      JWT_OIDC_JWKS_URI: "http://localhost:8081/auth/realms/forms-flow-ai/protocol/openid-connect/certs"
      JWT_OIDC_ISSUER: "http://localhost:8081/auth/realms/forms-flow-ai"
      JWT_OIDC_AUDIENCE: "forms-flow-web"
      JWT_OIDC_CACHING_ENABLED: "True"
      BPM_API_URL: "http://localhost:8080/camunda"
      BPM_CLIENT_SECRET: "demo"
      BPM_CLIENT_ID: "forms-flow-bpm"
      BPM_TOKEN_API: "http://localhost:8081/auth/realms/forms-flow-ai/protocol/openid-connect/token"
      INSIGHT_API_URL: "http://localhost:8080/analytics"
      INSIGHT_API_KEY: "test"
      FORMIO_URL: "http://localhost:8080/forms"
      FORMIO_ROOT_EMAIL: "test@test.com"
      FORMIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: "test"
      SKIP_IN_CI: "True"
      USE_DOCKER_MOCK: "True"

      JWT_OIDC_TEST_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM: ${{ secrets.JWT_OIDC_TEST_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM }}

      FORMIO_TEST_JWT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.FORMIO_TEST_JWT_TOKEN }}

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:11
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: postgres
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 #v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: forms-flow-api/requirements/dev.txt

      - name: Verify Docker
        run: |
          docker --version
          docker compose version

      - name: Check Docker Compose file
        run: |
          if [ ! -f tests/docker/docker-compose.yml ]; then
            echo "docker-compose.yml not found!"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          make build

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          make test


  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

      - name: Build Docker image
        run: |
          docker build \
            --tag forms-flow-api:ci \
            .

      - name: Verify Docker image
        run: |
          docker image inspect forms-flow-api:ci",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs lint/test/build on pull requests and dispatches with no concurrency control, so repeated pushes to the same branch/PR let stale runs finish and consume runner minutes. Evidence pattern P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE (partition cancellation by workflow and branch/PR; reported to reduce duplicate work) applies: these are CI checks, not deployment/release work, and grouping by github.head_ref for pull requests (falling back to github.ref otherwise) keeps distinct branches/PRs isolated while always preserving the latest run, so required coverage is unchanged. Dependency caching is already present via setup-python cache: pip in the lint and test jobs, and no safe per-job timeout can be derived without CI history, so no other change is made. No permissions, secrets, publishing, deployment, or new network access is added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}

    shell: bash
    working-directory: ./forms-flow-api

jobs:

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version:
          - "3.13.16"

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 #v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: forms-flow-api/requirements/dev.txt

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements/dev.txt

      - name: Pylint
        run: |
          pylint --rcfile=setup.cfg src/formsflow_api

      - name: Flake8
        run: |
          flake8 src/formsflow_api tests


  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version:
          - "3.13.16"

    env:
      FLASK_ENV: "testing"
      DATABASE_URL_TEST: "postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres"
      FORMSFLOW_API_URL: "http://localhost:5000"
      KEYCLOAK_URL: "http://localhost:8081"
      KEYCLOAK_URL_REALM: "forms-flow-ai"
      KEYCLOAK_BPM_CLIENT_SECRET: "demo"
      JWT_OIDC_WELL_KNOWN_CONFIG: "http://localhost:8081/auth/realms/forms-flow-ai/.well-known/openid-configuration"
      JWT_OIDC_ALGORITHMS: "RS256"
      JWT_OIDC_JWKS_URI: "http://localhost:8081/auth/realms/forms-flow-ai/protocol/openid-connect/certs"
      JWT_OIDC_ISSUER: "http://localhost:8081/auth/realms/forms-flow-ai"
      JWT_OIDC_AUDIENCE: "forms-flow-web"
      JWT_OIDC_CACHING_ENABLED: "True"
      BPM_API_URL: "http://localhost:8080/camunda"
      BPM_CLIENT_SECRET: "demo"
      BPM_CLIENT_ID: "forms-flow-bpm"
      BPM_TOKEN_API: "http://localhost:8081/auth/realms/forms-flow-ai/protocol/openid-connect/token"
      INSIGHT_API_URL: "http://localhost:8080/analytics"
      INSIGHT_API_KEY: "test"
      FORMIO_URL: "http://localhost:8080/forms"
      FORMIO_ROOT_EMAIL: "test@test.com"
      FORMIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: "test"
      SKIP_IN_CI: "True"
      USE_DOCKER_MOCK: "True"

      JWT_OIDC_TEST_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM: ${{ secrets.JWT_OIDC_TEST_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM }}

      FORMIO_TEST_JWT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.FORMIO_TEST_JWT_TOKEN }}

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:11
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: postgres
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 #v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: forms-flow-api/requirements/dev.txt

      - name: Verify Docker
        run: |
          docker --version
          docker compose version

      - name: Check Docker Compose file
        run: |
          if [ ! -f tests/docker/docker-compose.yml ]; then
            echo "docker-compose.yml not found!"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          make build

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          make test


  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

      - name: Build Docker image
        run: |
          docker build \
            --tag forms-flow-api:ci \
            .

      - name: Verify Docker image
        run: |
          docker image inspect forms-flow-api:ci
